consular.mission: Embassy of Canada, Kinshasa; Australian Embassy, Harare
consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy or consulate in the DRC. Our ability to provide consular assistance may be limited. The Canadian Embassy in Kinshasa provides consular assistance to Australians in the DRC. It can issue Australian provisional travel documents. Its services are limited outside Kinshasa.
